name: bankbridge
description: Read-only access to your own US bank, credit card and investment accounts at 12,000+ institutions: balances, transactions, spending by category or merchant, recurring charges, monthly cashflow and holdings. Hosted Streamable HTTP with OAuth 2.1; every call fetches live and transactions are not stored. Paid, $5/mo per connected bank.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP. Use an OAuth-capable MCP client and sign in to BankBridge (dynamic client registration, no key needed). Paid, $5/mo per connected bank; a demo account with sample data is available.
